  19 | class UserService(BaseService):
  20 |     """User management service."""
  21 |

  23 |         """Validate user data."""
  24 |         return True
  25 |     
  26 |     def _validate_email(self, email: str) -> bool:
  27 |         """Validate email format and domain.
  28 |         
  29 |         Checks against VALID_EMAIL_DOMAINS constant.
  30 |         """
  31 |         if '@' not in email:
  32 |             return False
  33 |         domain = email.split('@')[1]
  34 |         return domain in VALID_EMAIL_DOMAINS
  35 |     
  36 |     def create_user(self, username: str, password: str, email: str) -> bool:
  37 |         """Create a new user.
  38 |         
  39 |         Calls _validate_user and _hash_password.
  40 |         """
  41 |         # Calls _validate_user
  42 |         if not self._validate_user(username, password, email):
  43 |             return False
  44 |         
  45 |         # Calls _hash_password
  46 |         hashed = _hash_password(password)
  47 |         
  48 |         # Calls _validate_email
  49 |         if not self._validate_email(email):
  50 |             return False
  51 |         
  52 |         self.users[username] = {
  53 |             'password': hashed,
  54 |             'email': email,
  55 |             'role': USER_ROLE
  56 |         }
  57 |         return True
  58 |     
  59 |     def update_user(self, username: str, new_password: str) -> bool:
  60 |         """Update user password."""
  61 |         if username not in self.users:
  62 |             return False
  63 |         
  64 |         if not self._validate_user(username, new_password, self.users[username]['email']):
  65 |             return False
  66 |         
  67 |         hashed = _hash_password(new_password)
  68 |         self.users[username]['password'] = hashed
  69 |         return True
  70 |     
  71 |     def authenticate(self, username: str, password: str) -> str:
  72 |         """Authenticate user and return token."""
  73 |         if username not in self.users:
  74 |             raise InvalidTokenException("Invalid username")
  75 |         
  76 |         user = self.users[username]
  77 |         hashed = user['password']
  78 |         
  79 |         if _hash_password(password) != hashed:
  80 |             raise InvalidTokenException("Invalid password")
  81 |         
  82 |         token = generate_token(username)
  83 |         self.tokens[token] = {'user': username}
  84 |         return token
